title: Account settings
description: The "My Account" screen reached from Profile, plus all its pop-ups: editing the name and email, sending a password reset link, and deleting the account.

Error shown only when the password typed to confirm the deletion is wrong.

notes: Eleven keys have zero references anywhere in the app code and are leftovers from an earlier design of this screen: details_header, name_label, name_hint, save, saving, saved, reset_password_sent, reset_password_error, delete_account_title, delete_account_description, privacy_policy. They are kept in a trailing 'Currently unused' section rather than deleted, because removing them is a product/content decision.

guest_email_prompt and guest_password_prompt ARE referenced in the code but can never be seen: the account screen computes them and then hides the email and password rows entirely for signed-out visitors. Either the rows should be shown to guests (so these prompts appear) or both keys should be retired — a product decision.

email_edit_unavailable is not a rare error: saving a new email address always shows it, because email editing has not been implemented. Worth flagging to product — a translator will reasonably assume it is an edge case.

The app has grown newer strings on this screen that do NOT exist in the CMS schema, so they cannot be translated today: reset_password_sent_title, reset_password_sent_message, reset_password_done, reset_password_failed_title, reset_password_failed_message, reset_password_try_again, delete_account_confirmation_title, delete_account_confirmation_description, delete_account_confirmation_placeholder, not_now, confirm_identity_title, confirm_identity_description, and the sign_in_method_* group (label, email, apple, google, facebook, phone). Several are prominent (the whole delete confirmation screen and the reset-password success/failure screens). Adding them to the CMS schema is an engineering task, not something this ordering pass can fix.

delete_account is reused in three places (bottom button on the account screen, heading of the delete screen, red confirm button on the delete screen), so the wording has to work as both a heading and a button.

notes: CONTRACT BREAK CONFIRMED BY GREP. The CMS leaf is 'profile.privacy'; the app's matching screen keeps its text under 'profile.privacy_advertising' in assets/l10n/en.yaml, and its keys were renamed to the ads_* / product_* family. Overrides are applied by exact key name within a mapped leaf, so a renamed key silently does nothing.
Exactly 1 of the 19 keys still matches a key the app looks for: status_allowed. Everything else is renamed, split, merged, or removed.

Name-by-name mapping to the app's current keys: screen_title→title, status_not_allowed→status_off, advertising_title→ads_title, advertising_body_benefits→ads_body_why, advertising_body_change_hint→ads_body_change_anytime, product_analytics_title→product_title, product_analytics_description→product_body, learn_more_header→learn_more. advertising_body_intro was split into ads_body_intro_before_link + what_we_share + ads_body_intro_after_link, and advertising_body_never_share into ads_body_never_share_lead + ads_body_never_share_middle + ads_body_never_sell_lead + ads_body_never_sell_tail — so the two richText keys cannot be mapped one-to-one and need a schema change, not just a rename.

advertising_platforms_header and the three advertising_platform_* keys have no app counterpart at all: the app no longer lists the platforms separately, it names Meta, Apple Search Ads and Google Ads inside the intro sentence. Removing them is a product decision, so they are kept.

The four legal-link keys (privacy_policy_title/subtitle, terms_and_conditions_title/subtitle) are duplicates: the screen renders those two rows from profile.main, not from this leaf. Either point the screen at this leaf or drop these four — a product/engineering decision.

The app screen also has strings with no home in this leaf at all: status_loading, status_allowed_on and status_off_since (these last two contain a {date} placeholder that must be kept), what_we_share, read_more_here, the whole 'are you sure you want to turn this off' confirmation screen (ads_off_confirm_question, ads_off_confirm_body_before_link, ads_off_confirm_body_after_link, keep_on, turn_off), and three error messages (load_error, ads_update_error, product_update_error). None of these can be translated today.

There is also no preview mapping for this leaf, so this tab cannot currently be previewed in the CMS the way profile.account can. Recommend hiding or clearly banner-warning this tab for translators until the schema is realigned with profile.privacy_advertising.
